title: Ashai

{{Hatnote|This article is about the character in {{BotW}} and {{TotK}}. For the character in {{TP}}, see [[Ashei]].}} {{Infobox Character |image= {{Media |Model BotW= File:BotW Ashai Model.png |Model TotK= File:TotK Ashai Model.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |title= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= Ms. Ashai{{Cite|It's about time for Ms. Ashai's class to begin.|Dina|BotW}} |TotK= Ms. Ashai{{Cite|Ms. Ashai says it's still not OK to chat with voe... You're gonna get in trouble if you stay here!|Kalani|TotK}} }} |alias= |race= [[Gerudo]] |gender= Female |game= BotW, TotK |other= |era= [[Era of the Wilds]] |family= |voiceactor= |theme= |counter= }} {{Term/Store|Ashai||Series, BotW, TotK}} is a recurring character in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite|Ashai|Game Screen|BotW}}{{Cite|Ashai|Game Screen|TotK}} ==Biography== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Ashai is a [[Gerudo]] who lives in [[Gerudo Town]] and teaches two classes to young girls before they depart from Gerudo Town.{{Cite|Oh, are you interested in the classes I teach to vai before they set off from Gerudo Town?|Ashai|BotW}} In the past, she and [[Isha]] were involved in a love triangle with [[Aurie Taamu]], though both of them remained single in the end.{{Cite|That book was written by an amazing chef, Aurie Taamu. {{Small|Just between us... He was the voe that our teacher was in love with once. Or so I hear...}} If you can't reach it, would you like me to read it for you?|Dina|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Small|Apparently she and the teacher of the relationship class, Ashai, were embroiled in a tragic love triangle... They're both still single, so I guess we know how that went...}}|Cara|BotW}} If [[Link]] speaks to Ashai while she is walking through Gerudo Town, she introduces herself and asks Link if he is interested in taking her class, [["Voe and You"]].{{Cite|Sav'saaba! Oh... Are you interested in taking my class "Voe and You"? I'm Ashai.|Ashai|BotW}} Ashai explains that she teaches a relationship class during the day and a [[Cooking Class]] at night.{{Cite|During the day I teach a class on the voe of the world, and at night I teach cooking classes.|Ashai|BotW}} Ashai encourages Link to attend the Cooking Class at her home during the night and her relationship class in the barracks during the day.{{Cite|I teach a cooking class at my house at night. If you want, please stop by!|Ashai|BotW}}{{Cite|My "Voe and You" class is in the barracks. If you'd like, please stop by.|Ashai|BotW}} When speaking to Ashai in the Relationship Classroom before "Voe and You" begins, she asks if Link is interested in sitting in.{{Cite|Oh... Are you interested in sitting in on my class "Voe and You"? It may even teach you a thing or two!|Ashai|BotW}} She then assures Link that there is no hurry and that class does not begin until everyone arrives.{{Cite|There's no hurry—we won't be starting until everyone has arrived.|Ashai|BotW}} If Link speaks to Ashai during her relationship class, she invites Link to observe if he is interested.{{Cite|Oh... Would you be interested in my class on interacting with voe in the world outside this town?|Ashai|BotW}} If Link rejects her offer, Ashai asks if Link already has a loved one,{{Cite|Do you already care deeply for someone?|Ashai|BotW}} to which Link scratches the back of his head in embarrassment. Ashai then explains that the young girls in her class have never even met a man before and that it is her duty to prepare them for the world outside of Gerudo Town.{{Cite|These young vai have never even met a voe before.|Ashai|BotW}}{{Cite|It's my duty to help prepare them for what they'll encounter in the world beyond Gerudo Town, good and bad.|Ashai|BotW}} Should Link agree to observe the class, Ashai instructs everyone to demonstrate what they have been learning.{{Cite|OK, everyone! Let's show our cute observer what we've been learning in class!|Ashai|BotW}} Ashai then asks the class what to do when a "handsome voe" approaches them on the street.{{Cite|Now then... You're walking down the street on your way somewhere, and a handsome voe you've never met approaches...|Ashai|BotW}} [[Pasha]] stands up and answers that she would wave casually yet remain prepared in case he is a distraction for a bandit ambush.{{Cite|Oh! I would wave casually to him but also keep myself prepared in case he's a distraction for a bandit ambush!|Pasha|BotW}} Ashai praises Pasha for her solution and then reminds the class that sometimes men only look suspicious from being intimidated by a Gerudo.{{Cite|Excellent thinking, Pasha! That's a prudent approach to a new situation.|Ashai|BotW}}{{Cite|Remember that sometimes voe may look suspicious but are just being wary due to the sight of a daunting Gerudo.|Ashai|BotW}} [[Dina]] then stands up to share her solution, saying that she would enthusiastically greet the man and approach with her hands empty.{{Cite|Oh! I would enthusiastically greet him, approaching with a smile and with my hands clearly empty!|Dina|BotW}} Ashai praises Dina for her optimistic approach,{{Cite|Wow, Dina, that's a very optimistic approach to take!|Ashai|BotW}} adding that friendliness is a great way to relax others.{{Cite|Being overtly friendly is an excellent way to put the stranger's mind at ease!|Ashai|BotW}} Lastly, [[Risa]] stands to share her solution, saying that she would attack the man when he least suspects it.{{Cite|Oh! I would walk casually toward him and then strike a fierce blow when he least suspected it!|Risa|BotW}} Ashai dismisses Risa's solution and tells her that it is a crime.{{Cite|Risa... That would be a crime...|Ashai|BotW}} Ashai also asks her students what they would do if they encountered an injured voe lying on the ground.{{Cite|In your travels, you come upon an injured voe lying on the ground. What do you do?|Ashai|BotW}} Pasha responds that she will lift him over her shoulder and take him to the nearest person who can treat him.{{Cite|Oh! I immediately lift him up over my shoulder and carry him to the nearest person who can treat him!|Pasha|BotW}} Ashai will praise this answer, but she will remind Pasha to check for non-visible injuries before she moves someone.{{Cite|That's a very proactive answer, Pasha! Always be aware that an injured person may have non-visible injuries before you move them, though!|Ashai|BotW}} Next, Dina says she would figure out what is wrong with him and then make a medicine to treat him.{{Cite|Oh! I would determine what was the matter and make a medicine on the spot to treat him!|Dina|BotW}} Once again, Ashai will say Dina has a great answer, but she tells her to make sure he does not have any allergies to the ingredients she uses.{{Cite|Great answer, Dina! Just be careful that the voe doesn't have some sort of allergy to the ingredients in your medicine!|Ashai|BotW}} Finally, Risa will say that she would secretly take the voe back to her home, where she would help him recover.{{Cite|Oh! I would secretly bring him back to my home, where I could help him gradually recover!|Risa|BotW}} Ashai says that while Risa's sentiment is sweet, her plan is basically kidnapping.{{Cite|Risa...
A sweet sentiment...
But also basically kidnapping.|Ashai|BotW}} For her third question, Ashai asks her students what they will do when they are approached and spoken to by a voe whose attention they have sought.{{Cite|You are suddenly approached by a voe whose attention you've sought, and he abruptly engages you in conversation.|Ashai|BotW}} Pasha says she would pretend not to speak his language.{{Cite|Hrm... I would pretend that I don't know how to speak his language.|Pasha|BotW}} Ashai comments that her approach is interesting since it could inspire curiosity, and she explains it is unrealistic that he will know the language she pretends to.{{Cite|That's an interesting approach, Pasha! You could inspire some curiosity in the voe by doing that... Remember: it isn't unrealistic that the voe may actually speak the language you pretend to know, too!|Ashai|BotW}} Dina claims she will take the opportunity to examine his clothes to determine his social status.{{Cite|Oh! I would take the up-close opportunity to determine his social standing based on the clothes he's wearing!|Dina|BotW}} Ashai commends Dina on her good thinking, but reminds her that sometimes, if someone's nice clothes are dirty, they may wear something more casual.{{Cite|Ah, good thinking, Dina. Just remember that sometimes all of someone's good clothes are dirty, so they might wear something more casual.|Ashai|BotW}} Lastly, Risa says she would grab his hand and twist his wrist until he agreed to marry her.{{Cite|Oh! I would grab his hand and twist his wrist until he agreed to marry me!|Risa|BotW}} Ashai is left without words, and she tells Risa to speak to her after class.{{Cite|Wha... You'd... Risa... Let's talk after class.|Ashai|BotW}} Before her Cooking Class begins, she tells Link one might as well learn if there is more to learn.{{Cite|People around me say it's a bit much, but I say as long as there is something to learn, why not keep learning?|Ashai|BotW}} If Link agrees with her, she comments on Link's innocent expression.{{Cite|Heehee... You're wearing such an innocent expression, but you understand, yeah?|Ashai|BotW}} Ashai also explains to Link that she was planning a lesson on [[Creamy Heart Soup]], but she forgot the name of the [[Hearty Radish|heart-shaped vegetable]] in the [[Recipe]].{{Cite|Hmm... I was planning on {{Color BotW|Red|creamy heart soup}} for the lesson today, but I'm being a bit forgetful, it seems. I know that I need some {{Color BotW|Blue|fresh milk}}, one {{Color BotW|Blue|voltfruit}}, one {{Color BotW|Blue|hydromelon}}, and two heart-shaped vegetables... I just can't recall what the heart-shaped vegetable was...|Ashai|BotW}} Ashai assures herself that she will remember eventually.{{Cite|Well, I'm sure it'll come back to me eventually... Can't afford to lose my momentum in life!|Ashai|BotW}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Ashai House Poster.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}A poster in Ashai's house showing how to prepare Hearty Clam Chowder ==See Also== {{See Also| * "Voe and You" * Cooking Class * Gerudo Town * Relationship Classroom }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Gerudo, Hyruleans |characters= BotW, TotK }}
